description: PLATEAU 4 terrain with core:creationDate commented out on both the dem:ReliefFeature and the dem:TINRelief (the 08-dem common C05 input) read and written back: no core:creationDate is written on either, since the writer writes no element without a value, and the one triangle is written as dem:tin > gml:TriangulatedSurface > gml:trianglePatches > gml:Triangle with no ids, with dem:lod before dem:tin. New-world only: the legacy writer has no terrain support.
